comment: Single authority for the native GUI protocol tables. Edit this file, then run `python3 scripts/generate_protocol.py` to regenerate the committed Zig, Rust, Roc, and docs artifacts. `docs/native-gui-protocol.md` documents the add-a-field procedure.

text_fields.name: class
text_fields.doc: CSS class list for browser presentation.

text_fields.name: native_style
text_fields.doc: Versioned native presentation record; never encoded on the browser wire.

text_fields.name: native_drag_key
text_fields.doc: Bounded application key exposed by an internal drag source.

text_fields.name: native_placeholder
text_fields.doc: Static empty-field hint text shown while a controlled field is empty.

text_fields.name: native_image_source
text_fields.doc: Relative image source resolved against the process-wide assets root.

text_fields.name: native_font_family
text_fields.doc: Static font family joined into the element's inherited text style.

text_fields.name: native_fonts
text_fields.doc: Versioned embedded-font registration declaration; registered once at startup.

bool_fields.name: disabled
bool_fields.doc: Disables input while retaining native identity.

bool_fields.name: selected
bool_fields.doc: Native selected presentation, independent of checkbox state.

bool_fields.name: native_drop_target
bool_fields.doc: Marks an internal drop target that must bind a string-detail drop event.

bool_fields.name: native_read_only
bool_fields.doc: Refuses user edits and edit history while the control stays available at full contrast and in tab order.

raw_node.comment: Field order is ABI: Zig writes and Rust reads this extern record byte-for-byte. Types: u64, usize, slice (pointer+length borrowed UTF-8), style (18 u32 presentation record), viewport (2 u32 record).

fields.name: active
fields.doc: Nonzero while the element is mounted.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Committed parent element id, zero for the root.

fields.name: child_count
fields.doc: Committed child count; children are read through signals_child_at.

fields.name: click
fields.doc: Bound click event id, zero when unbound.

fields.name: input
fields.doc: Bound input event id, zero when unbound.

fields.name: check
fields.doc: Bound check event id, zero when unbound.

fields.name: style_present
fields.doc: Nonzero when the style record is populated (text field 8).

fields.name: viewport
fields.doc: Validated virtual-list record (text field 9), zeroed when absent.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.doc: Checked lifetime counter advanced on descriptor retirement.

fields.name: drop
fields.doc: Bound drop event id for an active drop target, zero otherwise (bool field 5).

fields.name: close_requested
fields.doc: Bound close-requested event id for a registered window (text field 11).

fields.name: close_policy
fields.doc: Close-decision word: 0 unregistered, KeepOpen=1, AwaitDecision=2, Close=3.

version_history.summary: Adds the source column to each scenario step so cross-language diagnostics identify the exact SCM form.
Adds the `native_read_only` boolean field and its node word: a control that refuses edits while staying readable and keyboard reachable, distinct from disabled.
Adds `signals_document_title`, the host read of the window identity decided by the shared engine's `SetDocumentTitle` command.
Extends the presentation record to style version 2 with hover and active background slots (18 u32 style record); style version 1 records are no longer accepted.
Adds the explicit image-source text slot together with the font-family and embedded-font declaration slots to the node layout.
Adds the placeholder text slot to the node layout.
Adds the close-request event ID and close-decision word to the node layout.
